CAMPAIGN STYLE SYSTEM

One city.
Four moods.

The original moodboard’s typographic MATIN KIM wordmark is paired with the expressive OFF THE CLOCK serif treatment. Every placement keeps the same documentary feeling, quiet expression and soft analog texture.

HEADLINES
Cormorant Garamond, italic editorial serif
SUPPORTING TYPE
Inter, clean and restrained labels
PRODUCT
Six-panel washed cotton caps, curved brim, cream tonal embroidery
CAMERA
Candid fashion portraits, natural movement, visible street texture
LIGHT
Overcast morning, subtle 35mm grain, realistic tones
AVOID
Neon, generic clock logos, hard retouching, cluttered commercial styling
